newsitem.title: USA: Elexsys sees Q2 earns significantly lower.
newsitem.headline: Elexsys sees Q2 earns significantly lower.

text.p: Elexsys International Inc said late on Monday that it expected "significantly reduced earnings" for the second quarter ending March 29 and warned it would not meet earnings expectations for the period.
Wall Street had expected the company to report earnings of $0.23 per share for the quarter, according to First Call consensus estimates.
The company said, however, that it would be profitable in the current quarter and expected to report higher sales compared to sales in the year-ago quarter.
In the year-ago quarter, the company reported earnings of $0.23 per share on sales of $30.4 million.
The electrical components maker attributed its outlook to higher production costs needed to replace and rebuild products.

"We are disappointed to have recently discovered some materials and internal production issues which will impact this quarter's earnings. However, we believe we are on course to correct certain problems encountered this quarter," the company said in a statement.
